verdict.rationale: Twenty's REST and GraphQL APIs explicitly support batching up to 60 records per request for create/update/delete, plus GraphQL batch upsert, and CSV/XLSX/API import with unlimited records for large-scale migrations, alongside export up to 20,000 records — directly enabling bulk operations across many items. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of batch API limits in practice and no documented bulk-delete-via-filter or bulk-edit-in-UI feature beyond import/export and API batching.
